# Required organization under whole generative comparison / 完整生成比较下的组织形成要求

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`organizational-formation-from-generative-comparison` · **reviewed-scoped** · argument · F07 · [record](organizational-formation-from-generative-comparison.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> In a finite nonempty eligible range, if every continuation lacking an organizational relation has a strictly better eligible construction, every undefeated choice includes that relation. This can warrant building or strengthening shared capacity without fixing one carrier.
>
> 在有限非空的合格接续中，若每种缺少某项组织关系的接续都有充分更好的合格构造，则所有未被击败的选择都包含该关系；这可支持建设或增强共同能力而不预定唯一承载。

## Conditions / 条件

- G0, explicit J1–J4 and complete relational correspondence; ethics is not deduced from monism alone.<br>G0、明确 J1–J4 与完整关系对应；不是从一元本体单独推出伦理。
- A finite nonempty eligible range, irreflexive transitive comparison and actual improvement witnesses for every deficient case; normative eligibility and basic classifications require substantive warrant.<br>有限非空的合格范围、严格传递比较、每个缺失情形的实际改善见证；规范资格与基本分类仍须辩护。

## Does not show / 未表明

- General generative structure does not supply full basic-content correspondence for unfamiliar new living.<br>一般生成结构未充分推出陌生新生活的基本内容。
- The requirement does not establish inevitable compliance.<br>规范要求不推出必然服从。
- It does not derive complete institutional authority.<br>无完整机构权限推导。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** Overbuilding actually depletes the living basis; identical construction reports fail to classify it. Faithful retained-amount information repairs this local omission.<br>过度建设实际耗尽生活基础；相同的建设报告不能判定基础。增加真实余量可修复本例的观察遗漏。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/universal-ethics/generative-capacity/RelationalOrganization.lean)

**Standard boundaries / 通用边界:** Premise-free (zero-substantive-axiom) grounding is a separate open target; completed G0/J results keep their scope. 无实质公理奠基是另一开放目标；已完成的 G0/J 成果保持原范围。

## Next / 下一步

Reuse robust classification. Where living-role classification changes implementation, establish decision-relevant substantive correspondence without requiring classification of all unfamiliar living before construction.<br>复用分类稳健比较。具体方案因真实生活作用分类而改变时，落实会改变决定的实质对应；不把全部陌生生活分类设为建设前提。

- 2026-10-15，整合 I3e（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述（Becoming.Decidedness 的列出之选项中不被胜过者，新增，不加前提；桥接 Judgment.required_of_bettered）。一个列出的非空选项表上，比较非自反、传递且在表上弱判定（¬p ∨ ¬¬p，WeaklyDecided；判定者都弱判定，Decided.weakly）时，有不被胜过的选项（exists_undominated）；不被胜过者不能缺少每个缺之者都被胜过的性质（Undominated.not_not_has），该性质判定时不被胜过者都有它（undominated_has）；比较与性质都判定时，不被胜过者都有它，恰当缺之的每个选项都被表上某选项胜过（undominated_has_iff）。在全部关系上，存在之律所需恰是弱排中律（exists_undominated_iff_weakly），去掉性质的判定恰是排中律（undominated_has_iff_em）。桥接：在确切列出的选项表上，PracticalJudgment 的前沿即不被胜过者（Judgment.frontier_iff_undominated），故比较弱判定、任务判定时，前沿非空且每个成员都完成任务（Judgment.required_of_bettered），即 formation_required_of_improvable_absence，不用经典推理。外围实例 OrganizationCorrespondence：以 Lean 的经典判定供给核心所要求者，formation_required_of_improvable_absence 由 exists_undominated 与 undominated_has 给出（formation_required_by_core），所构造的协调情形亦然（coordination_is_required_by_core）。比较、合格性与所构造的历史保持原范围；规范解释继承公开的 J 承诺。外围实例模块由其检查器以 Lean 4.30.0-rc2 与 Mathlib 实查（回执 20261015T163336.437151Z），只用标准公理：frontier_iff_undominated 的公理报告为空，formation_required_by_core 与 coordination_is_required_by_core 以 Lean 的经典判定供给核心所要求者、并用外围的 simp 引理（propext、Classical.choice、Quot.sound）；所实例化的核心律与桥接定理由核心运行审计（回执 20261015T163210.426211Z，公理报告为空）。 / 15 October 2026, integration I3e (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine (the new laws of Becoming.Decidedness for undominated members of a listed menu, no premise; the bridge’s Judgment.required_of_bettered). On a nonempty listed menu where the comparison is irreflexive, transitive and weakly decided (¬p ∨ ¬¬p, WeaklyDecided; whatever is decided is weakly decided, Decided.weakly), some member is undominated (exists_undominated); an undominated member cannot lack a property every member lacking it is bettered in (Undominated.not_not_has), and has it where the property is decided (undominated_has); where comparison and property are both decided, every undominated member has the property exactly where every member lacking it is bettered by some member (undominated_has_iff). Over all relations, the existence law needs exactly weak excluded middle (exists_undominated_iff_weakly), and dropping the decidedness of the property is exactly excluded middle (undominated_has_iff_em). Bridge: on an exact listed menu the frontier of PracticalJudgment is the undominated members (Judgment.frontier_iff_undominated), so where the comparison is weakly decided and the task decided, the frontier is not empty and every member of it performs the task (Judgment.required_of_bettered): formation_required_of_improvable_absence with no classical reasoning. Periphery instance OrganizationCorrespondence: with Lean’s classical decidedness supplying what the core asks, formation_required_of_improvable_absence follows from exists_undominated and undominated_has (formation_required_by_core), and so does the constructed coordination case (coordination_is_required_by_core). The comparison, eligibility and the constructed history keep their scope; the normative interpretation inherits the explicit J commitments. The periphery instance module is checked by its own checker with Lean 4.30.0-rc2 and Mathlib (receipt 20261015T163336.437151Z), standard axioms only: frontier_iff_undominated has an empty report, and formation_required_by_core and coordination_is_required_by_core supply what the core asks by Lean’s classical decidedness and use the periphery’s simp lemmas (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound); the core laws and bridge theorems it instantiates are audited by the core run (receipt 20261015T163210.426211Z, empty axiom reports).
